verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a change-history log of changes to flags and other resources, which supports versioning and rollback of a flag, and an approvals workflow for reviewing changes. These are documented for flag changes. The evidence does not show them applying to the product's automation objects, such as scheduled changes, adaptive triggers or guarded rollouts. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/review/rollback of automation objects (scheduled changes, triggers, rollout configs), diff/version comparison detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly keeps a running log of changes made to feature flags and other resources in each environment. You can also use the change history to roll back a flag
they have the option to request approval for that change from a member or team in their LaunchDarkly project.
